title: The Wrong Change in the Pocket
youtube_title: The Wrong Change in the Pocket | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Owning a mistake is how trust grows back.
summary: At a cottage hallway of hooks, rugs, and boots, Ximena is tangled up with a coin of wrong change still in a pocket and almost hides it. Ximena tells the baker the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
